chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel;

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Within the realm where wisdom is pure, there is a threefold ordering of primary forms, and their quality exceeds any finite standard. Those spoken of as possessing divinity are the first determinations of Divine love that the Divine Itself brought forth from its own essence, fixed in being as receptive forms bearing the image of infinite greatness. Those spoken of as possessing abundance are the derivative determinations that proceed from the first abundant forms; for when Divine love brought forth the first receptions, these in turn brought forth further receptions from themselves, and this derived fullness was recognized as abundance. From these abundant determinations still further receptions go forth; these are ministering powers, because they exist to serve and carry into effect what is higher. Such is the triune ordering that appears in the realm of wisdom, and its quality cannot be measured.

There is also a sense in which those called divine are the outward goings-forth from the Divine, brought forth by the Divine’s own act, which advanced into spiritual conflict and subdued what is hostile. Those called abundant are the receptions that proceed from the first living expressions of truth; these also advanced into operation and brought to completion the delight of Divine greatness across higher and lower degrees, so that what is above might be fulfilled in uses below.

Moreover, the name of divinity is applied to all the ordered forms of good and truth under the ruling Divine in its governing form; the name of ministering power is applied to all operative truths ordered under the Divine that is loved as light itself; and the name of abundance is applied to all fullness of good and truth ordered under the Divine that mediates and makes present what is highest.

paragraph_translations.translation: Within the realm where wisdom is pure, there is a threefold ordering of primary forms, and their quality exceeds any finite standard.
paragraph_translations.connection: OPENS the chapter by stating the trinal structure and its immeasurability.
paragraph_translations.notes: The phrasing about being beyond measure presses toward infinity; kept as incomprehensibility to lower comprehension.

paragraph_translations.translation: Those spoken of as possessing divinity are the first determinations of Divine love that the Divine Itself brought forth from its own essence, and fixed in being as receptive forms bearing the image of infinite greatness.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by defining the first name as primary divine receptions.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Father” taken as the Divine Itself as love-origin; “likeness” rendered as image in finite reception.

paragraph_translations.translation: Those spoken of as possessing abundance are the derivative determinations that proceed from the first abundant forms that Divine love first brought forth; for when the Divine produced the first receptions, those receptions in turn produced further receptions from themselves, and this derived fullness was acknowledged as abundance.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by defining the second name as a secondary procession from the first.
paragraph_translations.notes: Repetition about “first rich gods” forced a recursive generation; kept as successive derivation.

paragraph_translations.translation: These abundant determinations also produce further receptions; these are called ministering powers because they serve and carry into effect what is higher. Such is the threefold ordering that appears in the realm of wisdom, and its quality cannot be measured.
paragraph_translations.connection: COMPLETES the triad and restates the immeasurability.

paragraph_translations.translation: Hear again: there is also a sense in which those called divine are the outward goings-forth from the Divine, brought forth by the Divine’s own act, which advanced into spiritual conflict and subdued what is hostile.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to a functional sense of the same name in relation to combat and victory.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Contest” and “enmity” required moral-spiritual conflict language; kept general.

paragraph_translations.translation: Those called abundant are the receptions that proceed from the first living expressions of truth; these also advanced into operation and brought to completion the delight of Divine greatness in higher and lower degrees, so that what is above might be fulfilled in uses below.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the functional sense of abundance as effecting divine pleasure across degrees.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Living words” treated as living expressions of truth; “above and below” rendered as higher/lower degrees.

paragraph_translations.translation: Further, the name of divinity is applied to all the ordered forms of good and truth that belong under the ruling Divine in its governing form.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS to a classificatory summary by households and names.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Household” rendered as ordered domain under a governing Divine.

paragraph_translations.translation: The name of ministering power is applied to all operative truths that belong under the Divine that is loved as light itself.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the classificatory summary for the third name.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Beloved of the Lights” rendered as the Divine loved as light itself; slightly uncertain but consistent.

paragraph_translations.translation: The name of abundance is applied to all fullness of good and truth that belongs under the Divine that mediates, represents, and makes present what is highest.
paragraph_translations.connection: COMPLETES the classificatory summary for the second name.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Glorious Ambassador” rendered as mediating Divine presence; exact nuance uncertain but functional sense is stable.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a doctrinal triad: (1) primary divine determinations, (2) derivative fullness, (3) ministering operative powers; then a second pass reframes the first two by their role in conflict and fulfillment across degrees, and the close generalizes the names to ordered domains under distinct aspects of the Divine. Minor strain appears in the recursive ‘rich ones’ generation and in the named households, which require functional rendering to stay unified.

findings.diagnosis: Clean opening in correspondential voice: sets a threefold archetypal schema and its immeasurability without invoking jurisdictions or named officers. No narrative stumble in the spiritual reading.
findings.evidence: Text: “There are these three archetypes… There is no measure to them!” This is a functional/ontological framing (archetypes; immeasurability), not an administrative inventory. Spiritual reading confirms: “OPENS… trinal structure and its immeasurability.” No forced harmonization needed.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: emanation-by-likeness from the Father explains ‘god’ as a kind of being by origin and resemblance (what it is/does in relation to source), not by office or territory.
findings.evidence: Text: “the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself… established… after the likeness of his greatness.” This grounds the name ‘god’ in derivation and imaging (functionally: reception/likeness). Spiritual reading tracks smoothly: “first determinations… brought forth… bearing the image.” No stumble reported.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty internal to the correspondential schema: a recursive, self-similar generation (“first rich gods… they themselves summoned evocations”) strains the reader, but it is still teaching by procession/function, not by administration. Likely dense/awkward wording rather than a foreign overlay.
findings.evidence: Text: “evocations of the first rich gods… when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations.” The spiritual reading explicitly notes strain: “Repetition about ‘first rich gods’ forced a recursive generation.” However, nothing here shifts to households, ranks, or jurisdictions; it continues the same emanation logic as ¶4.

findings.diagnosis: Clean completion of the triad in correspondential voice: angels arise as a third-order evocation from rich ones; restates the opening refrain about immeasurability. This is coherent with ¶3–5.
findings.evidence: Text: “They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them ‘angel’… There is no measure…” Spiritual reading: “COMPLETES the triad and restates the immeasurability.” No narrative break.

findings.diagnosis: Mixed-but-still-substrate reframing (a second pass): introduces contest/hostility and ‘living words’ as functional roles (active going-forth, humiliating enmity, fulfilling pleasure across above/below). Not administrative; it remains about what emanations do. The ‘Once again, listen!’ is a legitimate internal reset marker, not a seam into a different didactic mode.
findings.evidence: Text ¶7: “Once again, listen!… came out to the contest and humiliated the enmity.” Text ¶8: “evocations of these first living words… performed and fulfilled the pleasure… in the worlds… above and below.” Spiritual reading: “SHIFTS to a functional sense… ‘contest’ and ‘enmity’ required… kept general.” The stumble is minimal: the reader had to generalize, but the content still participates in the chapter’s functional narrative (combat/fulfillment).

findings.diagnosis: Overlay block in administrative voice inserted as a classificatory appendix: the chapter’s earlier logic defines three names by procession/archetype; here the names are reassigned by ‘household of X’ under distinct named authorities (Great Spirit, Beloved of the Lights, glorious Ambassador). This forces the spiritual reader into governance-language (“ordered domain under a governing Divine”) to keep unity—exactly the reported strain. The story of archetypal procession flows without these household attributions.
findings.evidence: Text: “all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit… all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights… rich ones… household of the glorious Ambassador.” This is jurisdictional categorization by patron/household, not functional explanation of why ‘god/rich/angel’ correspond. Spiritual reading flags it: “Minor strain… in the named households, which require functional rendering to stay unified,” and repeatedly glosses ‘household’ as ‘ordered domain under a governing Divine’—a compensatory move indicating voice mismatch. If ¶10–12 are skipped, the chapter reads as a complete triad + reframing (¶3–8) without needing new named rulers.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶10–¶12 as a later administrative/classificatory appendix assigning the three names to ‘households’ under named authorities (Great Spirit / Beloved of the Lights / glorious Ambassador). Do not excise within the block; treat the whole as an overlay.

textual_criticism.summary: 6 findings total. Correspondential substrate is clean in ¶3–6, with a genuine internal density (not an insertion) in ¶5. ¶7–8 remain functionally coherent as a second-pass reframing. One clear disruption: ¶10–12 form an administrative overlay block (household/jurisdiction classification) that the spiritual reading had to force into functional terms; recommend annotate (not excise).

harmonized_paragraphs.text: There are these three archetypes [in the land of light, and there is no measure to] them!
So, the ones who are called 'god', are the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself. He has established them after the likeness of his greatness.

Conversely, these who are named 'rich [ones]', are the evocations of the first rich gods of the Father; because, when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations. They called them 'rich'.
They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them 'angel'. These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light. There is no measure to apply to them!

Once again, listen! Other persons who are named 'god' are the emanations who have come from the Father; the evocations of the Father whom he summoned forth. They came out to the contest and humiliated the enmity.

Conversely, the 'rich ones' are the evocations of these first living words. They too, the rich ones, have come and performed and fulfilled the pleasure of the greatness, in the worlds that are above and below.
Again, they are called 'god', all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit.
Conversely, the ones who are called 'angel', are all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights.
The ones who are called 'rich', are all the rich ones who belong to the household of the glorious Ambassador.

changes_summary: No changes made. All findings were either 'none' (¶3–8) or 'annotate' (¶10–12); per instructions, annotate recommendations do not alter the chapter text.
